title: Polished Nickel 18-Inch Wall Mount Towel Bar - Solid Brass Straight Bar, Carolina Collection (Traditional Style), Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Polished Nickel, stop settling for flimsy towel bars and mismatched finishes—this 18-inch wall mount towel bar brings a clean, coordinated look to your bathroom, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces. Backed by a lifetime warranty, it’s crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use.

Part of the Carolina collection—a traditional, timeless suite designed for matching Carolina bathrooms and classic bath accessories.

  • Polished Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Holds up to 10 lb for dependable daily use
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Choose from multiple designer finish options to coordinate with traditional bathroom hardware

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Carolina collection.

Specs

  • Product type: Towel bar (straight bar)
  • Center-to-center: 18 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Projection (depth): 2 in
  • Overall height: 3.5 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
  • Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
meta_description: 18-inch wall mount towel bar in solid brass with concealed mounting. Traditional Carolina collection style, multiple finish options, limited lifetime warranty.
